hook_text: One market day in Upington uses every Term 1 skill. Can you spot them all?
clip_script: Market day in Upington. Takings R148 365 last year, R153 840 this year. Which is bigger? Compare from the left: 5 beats 4. How much more? 153 840 minus 148 365: R5 475. Check: add back, 153 840. Visitors: 12 476 plus 9 858: 22 334. Round the takings to the nearest 1 000: R148 000. 24 stalls at R135: split 24 into 20 and 4, 2 700 plus 540, R3 240. Raffle every 15 minutes, lucky draw every 20: together after 60. Lemonade 1 to 5: 4 litres of syrup, 20 of water. Place value, sentences, columns, multiplying, factors, ratio. Estimate first, check with the inverse.
visual_style: A market day whiteboard with each stall labelled by the skill it uses, ticking off one by one.
mood: Lively, like a market crowd with a confident cashier.
pacing: Rapid tour from the takings board to the gate to the stalls, one skill per beat.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and do one practice question from every Term 1 topic.
